text: {"lessons":["I should avoid selling a stock just because it is below my cost, as with Stock E and Stock D; I need a forward-looking reason and a clear exit rule.","I should resist frequent reactive trading: selling Stock C after a small loss and buying Stock A, then later selling A at a loss, reinforces the need for a consistent thesis before changing positions.","I should manage position sizes and cash deliberately, and assess my results over many periods against the market rather than treating a short run of gains as proof that my decisions are sound."]}
